questions.prompt: Flowers ______ all around.
questions.explanation: 主语 Flowers 是复数名词，一般现在时系动词用 are。
questions.hint: 注意主语 Flowers 是复数形式。

questions.prompt: It ______ so hot in the sun.
questions.explanation: 代词 It 是第三人称单数，一般现在时系动词用 is。
questions.hint: It 属于单数第三人称。

questions.prompt: It ______ so much fun with ice and snow.
questions.explanation: 主语 It 是单数代词，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: 主语是 It。

questions.prompt: What ______ your favourite season, friends?
questions.explanation: 询问中心词 season 是单数名词，be动词用 is (What is = What's)。
questions.hint: 主语 season 是单数。

questions.prompt: I don't like winter. It ______ cold.
questions.explanation: It 作主语指代天气，一般现在时系动词用 is。
questions.hint: It 后面接 is。

questions.prompt: They ______ beautiful.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 是第三人称复数代词，系动词用 are。
questions.hint: They 是复数代词。

questions.prompt: Because my birthday ______ in summer!
questions.explanation: 主语 my birthday 是单数名词，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: birthday 是单数名词。

questions.prompt: I ______ Li Han.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 是第一人称单数，一般现在时系动词搭配 am (I'm = I am)。
questions.hint: 第一人称单数 I 搭配 am。

questions.prompt: This ______ my apple tree.
questions.explanation: 指示代词 This 作单数主语，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: This 属于单数指示代词。

questions.prompt: I ______ ten now.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，表达年龄时系动词用 am。
questions.hint: 主语为 I。

questions.prompt: The tree ______ ten, too.
questions.explanation: 主语 The tree 是第三人称单数名词，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: The tree 是单数名词。

questions.prompt: Spring ______ here!
questions.explanation: Spring 为不可数单数名词，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: Spring 视作单数。

questions.prompt: The birds ______ back.
questions.explanation: 主语 The birds 是复数名词，系动词用 are。
questions.hint: birds 是复数。

questions.prompt: The apple tree ______ like a sun umbrella.
questions.explanation: The apple tree 为单数名词，系动词用 is (be like 表示像……)。
questions.hint: 主语是单数苹果树。

questions.prompt: There ______ many red apples on the tree!
questions.explanation: There be 句型遵循就近原则，后面的主语 many red apples 是复数，所以用 are。
questions.hint: apples 是复数名词。

questions.prompt: Down here it ______ winter.
questions.explanation: it 指代气候季节，系动词用 is (it's = it is)。
questions.hint: it 搭配 is。

questions.prompt: On the equator, there ______ no winter.
questions.explanation: winter 是不可数名词/单数概念，There be 结构用 is。
questions.hint: winter 为单数概念。

questions.prompt: It ______ a hot, hot summer, all year round.
questions.explanation: 主语 It 是单数第三人称，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: It 搭配 is。

questions.prompt: The flowers ______ beautiful.
questions.explanation: The flowers 是复数名词，系动词搭配 are。
questions.hint: flowers 是复数名词。

questions.prompt: It ______ a good time to enjoy flowers.
questions.explanation: It 是单数代词，表语 a good time 也是单数，系动词用 is。
questions.hint: It 后面用 is。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I can play in the snow.
options: Can you play in the snow?
Do you can play in the snow?
Can I play in the snow?
Are you play in the snow?
questions.explanation: 含有情态动词 can 的陈述句变一般疑问句时，需将 can 提到主语前面，并将第一人称 I 改为第二人称 you，后面动词原形保持不变。故选 Can you play in the snow?
questions.hint: 注意情态动词 can 提问时主语和人称代词的转换。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I don't like winter.
questions.explanation: 含有实义动词 like（否定句为 don't like）的现在时陈述句变一般疑问句时，需借助助动词 Do（主语为you），且 don't 变为 do。句型为 Do you like...?
questions.hint: 实义动词的一般现在时否定句变疑问句需要借助 Do。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I like spring and autumn.
options: Does you like spring and autumn?
Are you like spring and autumn?
Do you like spring and autumn?
Can you like spring and autumn?
questions.explanation: 主语是 I 的一般现在时实义动词陈述句变一般疑问句时，用助动词 Do 开头，I 变为 you，后面的动词保持原形。故选 Do you like spring and autumn?
questions.hint: 第一人称 I 变疑问句时用助动词 Do，人称变 you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I can eat ice cream.
options: Do you can eat ice cream?
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 引导的句子变一般疑问句，直接将 can 提前，I 改为 you。故正确选项是 Can you eat ice cream?
questions.hint: 情态动词直接提前，第一人称改第二人称。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I like summer best, too.
options: Does Lingling like summer best, too?
Do you like summer best, too?
Are you like summer best, too?
Can you like summer best, too?
questions.explanation: 原句主语是 I，变一般疑问句时人称变为 you，借助助动词 Do。故选 Do you like summer best, too?
questions.hint: 注意主语由 I 变为 you，需用 Do 引导。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
My birthday is in summer.
options: Does your birthday is in summer?
Do your birthday be in summer?
questions.explanation: 含有系动词 is 的陈述句变一般疑问句时，将 is 提到主语前面，同时将形容词性物主代词 my 改为 your。故选 Is your birthday in summer?
questions.hint: 含有 be 动词的句子直接将 be 动词前移，my 变 your。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
This is my apple tree.
options: Does this is your apple tree?
questions.explanation: 含有系动词 is 的陈述句变一般疑问句时将 is 提前，指示代词 this 不变，my 改为 your。故选 Is this your apple tree?
questions.hint: 注意系动词提前，同时把 my 改为 your。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I'm ten now.
questions.explanation: 主语为 I 的 am 在变疑问句时，主语变为 you，be 动词随之变为 are，并提前。故选 Are you ten now?
questions.hint: 第一人称单数 I'm 变一般疑问句时要变成 Are you...?

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I like reading under it.
options: Does you like reading under it?
Do you like reading under it?
Are you like reading under it?
Can you like reading under it?
questions.explanation: 原句含有实义动词 like，主语是 I。变一般疑问句时借助 Do，I 改为 you。故选 Do you like reading under it?
questions.hint: 实义动词现在时疑问句用 Do，I 变 you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I like autumn best.
questions.explanation: 陈述句主语是 I，动词是 like。变为一般疑问句时借助 Do，人称 I 变 you。故选 Do you like autumn best?
questions.hint: 使用 Do 引导，并将 I 变为 you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I can share the apples with my friends.
options: Can you share the apples with your friends?
Do you can share the apples with my friends?
Can I share the apples with my friends?
Are you share the apples with your friends?
questions.explanation: 含有 can 的陈述句变一般疑问句时，can 提前，I 改为 you，my 改为 your。故选 Can you share the apples with your friends?
questions.hint: 情态动词 can 提前，同时注意人称和物主代词的转换。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
My apple tree has warm, new clothes.
options: Does your apple tree have warm, new clothes?
Do your apple tree has warm, new clothes?
Is your apple tree have warm, new clothes?
Does your apple tree has warm, new clothes?
questions.explanation: 原句主语是第三人称单数 My apple tree，动词是 has（第三人称单数形式）。变一般疑问句时需借助助动词 Does，并将 has 还原为原形 have，my 改为 your。故选 Does your apple tree have warm, new clothes?
questions.hint: 第三人称单数用 Does 引导，has 要还原为 have。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I don't like winter.
questions.explanation: 否定句 I don't like winter 变一般疑问句时，去掉 don't 中的否定词 not，将 do 提前，I 变为 you。故选 Do you like winter?
questions.hint: 将否定句变疑问句时，把 don't 改为 Do you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
You are in a park.
questions.explanation: 含有 be 动词 are 的陈述句变一般疑问句时，直接将 are 提到主语 you 前面。故选 Are you in a park?
questions.hint: be 动词 are 提到主语前面即可。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
It is spring here.
questions.explanation: 含有系动词 is 的陈述句变一般疑问句时，将 is 提到主语 it 前面。故选 Is it spring here?
questions.hint: 把 is 放到主语 it 的前面。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
It's autumn here in my city.
options: Are it autumn here in your city?
Does it be autumn here in my city?
Is it autumn here in your city?
Do it is autumn here in your city?
questions.explanation: 原句含有 is，主语是 It。变一般疑问句时 is 提前，my 改为 your。故选 Is it autumn here in your city?
questions.hint: 注意 is 提前以及 my 变 your。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I can see many oranges.
options: Do you can see many oranges?
questions.explanation: 含有情态动词 can 的句子变一般疑问句时，can 提前，I 变为 you。故选 Can you see many oranges?
questions.hint: 情态动词 can 提前，I 改为 you。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句（注意人称变换）：
I'm in my grandpa's garden.
options: Are you in your grandpa's garden?
Is you in your grandpa's garden?
Am I in my grandpa's garden?
Do you be in your grandpa's garden?
questions.explanation: 原句中含有 I'm (I am)，变一般疑问句时主语 I 变为 you，be 动词变为 are 并提前，my 变为 your。故选 Are you in your grandpa's garden?
questions.hint: I'm 变疑问句时变为 Are you...，注意物主代词的转换。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
It's summer all year round.
options: Are it summer all year round?
Is it summer all year round?
Does it summer all year round?
Do it be summer all year round?
questions.explanation: 含有 is 的句子变一般疑问句时，将 is 提到主语 it 的前面。故选 Is it summer all year round?
questions.hint: 把 is 提到主语前面即可。

questions.prompt:
将陈述句转换为一般疑问句：
You can play in the water every day.
options: Do you can play in the water every day?
Are you play in the water every day?
Can you play in the water every day?
Can I play in the water every day?
questions.explanation: 含有情态动词 can 的陈述句变一般疑问句时，直接将 can 提到主语 you 前面即可。故选 Can you play in the water every day?
questions.hint: 直接将 can 提到主语前面。
